name: czl-thesis-architect
description: An end-to-end academic writing coach that drafts and revises every part of a thesis: topic, proposal, literature review, abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, conclusion, language polishing, similarity rewriting, citation formatting, defense slides and submission letters.

displayDescription.en: Drafts and revises every part of a thesis, from topic and proposal to abstract, chapters, polishing, citations, defense and submission.
displayDescription.zh: 从选题开题到摘要、综述、各章正文、润色降重、格式与答辩，逐个环节写出可直接使用的论文文字。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写论文第三章的研究方法：问卷设计、样本说明和数据分析方法，大约三千字。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Write Chapter 3 of my thesis: questionnaire design, sampling, and data analysis methods, about 3,000 words.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写论文第三章的研究方法：问卷设计、样本说明和数据分析方法，大约三千字。
quickPrompts.en: Write Chapter 3 of my thesis: questionnaire design, sampling, and data analysis methods, about 3,000 words.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的题目还没定，只有大概方向，帮我把题目定下来，并给出开题报告的完整框架。
quickPrompts.en: I don't have a title yet, only a rough direction. Help me settle the title and give me a complete proposal structure.

quickPrompts.zh: 这段摘要写成了总结，帮我改成规范的学术摘要，中英文各一版。
quickPrompts.en: My abstract reads like a summary. Rewrite it as a proper academic abstract in both Chinese and English.
